summary: An unrepresented crew at {workplace} decides together to leave a cold shop after individual complaints have failed.
realLife: Several Washington Aluminum machinists had complained about the cold before the furnace failed. Most of the shift then left together without first presenting a formal demand for repairs.
gates: The case record identifies the earlier complaints, shared decision, shop conditions and departure.
inGame: needs: earlier complaints, shared decision, shop conditions and departure.

turns.what: Witnesses can describe the common reason for leaving.
The record reflects their individual reasons.
turns.pulledBy: Workers leave independently for unrelated reasons
